items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-05-27
items.q: I've inquired a couple times, but he wasn't too free with his information.

ctx.x: Well, we can ask Buddy, the sextant over there. Do you know Buddy?
I don't think he does. I've inquired a couple times, but he wasn't too free with his information.
Well, you know, he was a friend of Buddy Petit's and all the musicians, that guy. Who's this? The sextant over there
